decisions.title: Extract cohort selection + guards into packages/practice-cohort, keep emitPracticeSkipped in batch-runner
decisions.chose: Move resolveCohort, evaluateGuards, the pure predicates, and SkipReason into a new @attribution-service/practice-cohort package; emitPracticeSkipped stays in batch-runner and the new package declares no @pathccm/observability dependency at all.
decisions.rejected: Moving emitPracticeSkipped into the shared package alongside selection/guards.
decisions.why: A future dashboard preview must not move batch counters. Keeping the emitter with the batch and excluding the observability dependency from the shared package makes that a structural guarantee, not a convention someone could violate by importing DefaultStats into shared code.

decisions.title: Split cohort selection from metric emission via an optional onPageFetched callback
decisions.chose: resolveCohort in the shared package takes an optional onPageFetched callback; batch-runner wraps it in services/cohort.ts, passing the callback and emitting its own size gauge, so COHORT.PAGE_FETCHED and COHORT.SIZE still fire exactly as before.
decisions.rejected: Emitting the Datadog counters directly inside the shared resolveCohort.
decisions.why: A future read-only caller (the dashboard preview) can call the shared resolver with no callback, with no code path by which it emits a batch metric.

decisions.title: Package boundary enforced by a test, not left as a comment
decisions.chose: package-boundary.test.ts asserts the dependency list is exactly [@attribution-service/data] and excludes @pathccm/observability.
decisions.rejected: Documenting the no-observability constraint only in a comment.
decisions.why: A comment can rot silently; a test that enumerates the exact dependency list fails loudly the moment someone adds an observability import.

provenanceTrail.reason: All five pre-existing batch-runner service test files pass with only import paths changed, no assertion touched.

decisions.title: New package follows the /add-package checklist
decisions.chose: Own workspace under packages/, Dockerfile dist wiring, tsconfig project reference, CLAUDE.md tree entry.
decisions.rejected: Folding the extracted code into an existing common/ package.
decisions.why: A dedicated workspace is what makes the dependency-boundary test meaningful; a shared common/ package would already carry other deps.
